jp: すみません、この肉[にく]を薄[うす]く{切[き]ってください|pt-tekudasai}。
en: Excuse me, please slice this meat thinly.
d: 切[き]ってはいけません
why: Asking the listener to do something is the て-form plus ください; the other forms give permission, a ban or a suggestion.

jp: 高[たか]いですね。もう少[すこ]し{安[やす]くしてください|pt-tekudasai}。
en: It's expensive, isn't it. Please make it a bit cheaper.
d: 安[やす]くしてもいいです
安[やす]くしてはいけません
why: Asking the listener to do something is the て-form plus ください; the other forms give permission, a ban or a suggestion.

jp: 熱[あつ]いので、まだ{飲[の]まないでください|pt-tekudasai}。
en: It's hot, so please don't drink it yet.
d: 飲[の]まなければなりません
why: Asking the listener NOT to do something is the ない-form plus でください; the other forms request the action, suggest it or oblige it.
